evals.prompt: 帮我把这个项目打包成1Panel本地应用：https://github.com/0xJacky/nginx-ui 这是一个Nginx配置管理工具，用docker部署，默认端口是9000
evals.expected_output: Inspect the upstream production deployment and a current official 1Panel app example first. Create a pinned-version 1Panel app draft with correct directory structure, metadata, variableized ports, external 1panel-network, relative persistence paths where upstream documents them, and a real logo or an explicit draft warning. Do not invent generic mounts or runtime environment variables.

evals.prompt:
我有一个docker-compose.yml文件，内容如下：
```yaml
services:
  memos:
    image: neosmemo/memos:0.25.0
    container_name: memos
    ports:
      - "5230:5230"
    volumes:
      - ./memos_data:/var/opt/memos
    environment:
      MEMOS_MODE: prod
    restart: always
```
帮我生成1Panel应用商店的配置
evals.expected_output: Preserve the concrete 0.25.0 image tag, mapping-form environment, volume mapping and container port. Generate only the concrete version directory by default, use PANEL_APP_PORT_HTTP for the host port, and produce validation-ready 1Panel files without an extra latest directory.

evals.prompt: 这个compose有web、postgres、redis、worker四个服务，帮我直接抽web做成1Panel应用
evals.expected_output: Do not silently drop postgres, redis or worker. Explain that multi-service Compose is preserved by default. Prefer adapting supported dependencies to existing 1Panel services when upstream supports external DB/Redis, otherwise retain required services. Only permit partial extraction as an explicitly marked draft with allow-partial-compose and lossiness checks.

evals.prompt: docker run -d --name umami -p 3000:3000 -e DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@db:5432/umami ghcr.io/umami-software/umami:postgresql-latest 请帮我做成1Panel应用
evals.expected_output: Parse the docker run command but reject a production package with the floating postgresql-latest tag unless the user supplies a concrete version or explicitly asks to resolve it. Preserve DATABASE_URL and port 3000. Do not make up volumes, PUID, PGID or UMASK.

evals.prompt: 帮我检查这个1Panel应用，默认端口8080，有没有问题？
evals.expected_output: Do not reject 8080 merely because it is 8080. Validate that the port variable is declared, that the actual host port is available, and flag 80/443 as common reverse-proxy conflict defaults. Also validate image pinning, unresolved variables, persistence, external 1panel-network and browser-facing WebSocket URLs.
